telegram.title: ## Connect Telegram
telegram.body:
We recommend linking your Telegram account right away.

- **Account recovery** — if you forget your Desktop password, you can only restore access through a linked Telegram account.
- **Remote access & sync** — send requests and chat with your assistant from your phone when you're away from your computer.

You can link your account anytime in Settings.

features.title: ## Privacy & Ecosystem
features.body:
You have full control over AI tools and integration with your environment:

- **Restrictions** — at any time you can cut off the bot's internet access, block PC command execution, disable subagent creation, or enable Guest Mode for a clean-slate conversation.
- **Smart Home** — connect Yandex Smart Home or local devices via Zigbee2MQTT. The assistant can control lights, outlets and climate.
- **Voice control** — the assistant is ready to listen. Say 'Alexa', 'Hey Jarvis', 'Hey Mycroft', or 'Hey Rhasspy'. You can choose the assistant's voice in the Voice tab or disable wake-word listening in **Settings → Restrictions**.

experimental.title: ## Experimental Features
experimental.body:
We regularly add new features. Here's what you can try right now:

- **DevOps Agent** — built-in SSH tool. Run commands on remote servers with safe manual-confirmation policies.
- **Maps & Routes** — AI can search for places and build routes on an interactive map in the right panel.
- **Dice Roll Mode (d20)** — for tabletop fans. Adds a virtual dice roll that determines the success of actions and guides the narrative in AI responses (enable in **Settings → Application**).
